scenario: 今天生成式检索的主线是让模型只生成合规的候选。TS-GEAR 把配送范围编进 SID 前缀，RoutingTrie 在每步 beam 选择前屏蔽走不通的分支，LEGIT 在一次写完整页时逐 token 检查，并发现主要开销来自 CPU 和 GPU 之间的等待。AST 往上游走一步，把 SID 建成树上的路径。用户需求没说清时，IntentLens 靠调用工具补全，SituRecBench 测模型在 3D 商店里边问边带路的能力。CloseSort 在一类带环的偏好结构上给出榜单合并的精确解法。

papers.title: TS-GEAR: Taobao Shangou GEnerative Ad Retrieval
papers.authors: Guofeng Tong, Xu Zhang, Guangliang Yu, Haiqiang Wang, Guannan Cong, Xing Guo, Yang Zhou, Jingjing Duan, Shuang Li, Feng Shi, Hualei Liu
papers.abstract: On-demand delivery platforms such as DoorDash and Uber Eats impose a constraint absent in traditional e-commerce: merchants beyond the user's delivery range are invalid candidates rather than merely low-ranked. Generative retrieval has recently shown strong potential in large-scale retrieval systems. Adapting it to this setting, however, poses three challenges. First, existing semantic IDs encode geography only as a soft signal, so reachability can only rely on a non-differentiable post-generation hard truncation. Second, user preferences vary substantially across both regions and queries, so aggregating historical behaviors without conditioning on geography and the current query yields biased interest estimates. Third, the retrieved candidate set is evaluated by its collective value, yet autoregressive training scores each sequence independently, with no set-level signal to discourage redundant near-duplicates. To address the challenges, we propose TS-GEAR, a unified generative retrieval framework for on-demand delivery: (1) Geo-Semantic ID splits merchant identifiers into geographic prefixes and semantic suffixes, making reachability a prediction target rather than a post-hoc filter; (2) Query-Geo Target Attention aggregates historical behaviors using the real-time query and location as dual targets, while encoding each behavior's own location into its attention key; (3) GMPO (Group Marginal Policy Optimization) rewrites advantages using a deduplicated group reward and marginal advantage within GRPO, avoiding auxiliary diversity objectives. Deployed online with a lightweight 0.1B backbone, TS-GEAR serves over 150 million queries per day in the search advertising pipeline of Taobao Shangou, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative retrieval methods on both HitRate and geographic validity, and achieving 3.8% gains in ad impressions and 4.2% in ad revenue.
papers.scoring_note: 生成式广告召回；明确线上规模与收入实验
papers.summary: 外卖搜索里，送不到的商家就是无效候选，而常见的 SID 只编码内容，这些商家要等生成完才被过滤，白白占掉 beam。淘宝闪购的 TS-GEAR 把位置写进 ID：前三个 token 来自地理网格编码，后三个才是内容语义，解码时前两个 token 直接限定在用户所在格子和周围八格。线上检索半径下，它前 50 个候选有 95.8% 送得到，最强基线 OneLoc 只有三成多。论文的解释是，==位置参与端到端生成后，模型才学到可达范围内该怎么排序==，事后过滤只能删掉不合格的。线上 A/B 实验里广告收入提升 4.2%。

papers.title: Not All Branches Are Equal: Adaptive Semantic ID Construction for Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Guy Hadad, Haggai Roitman, Bracha Shapira
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation models represent items as sequences of discrete tokens known as semantic IDs. Existing approaches derive these identifiers using residual or hierarchical vector quantization, assuming that tokens carry independent semantic meaning across quantization levels. Revisiting this assumption, we argue that semantic IDs should behave as hierarchical paths where each token's meaning is conditioned on its prefix. This highlights a mismatch between conventional fixed-codebook quantization and the hierarchical structure implicitly learned by generative recommenders. Motivated by this insight, we propose Adaptive Silhouette Tree (AST), a top-down divisive clustering method that constructs semantic IDs as paths within a tree structure. Unlike prior methods with fixed branching factors, AST dynamically determines the number of branches at each node by maximizing the silhouette coefficient, enabling finer partitions in dense regions and compact groupings in homogeneous ones. We further introduce constrained variants that enforce minimum probability mass during splitting to improve supervision for long-tail items. Extensive experiments on five Amazon Review datasets of varying sizes and domains show that AST significantly outperforms strong baselines. These results demonstrate that aligning semantic ID construction with the inherent hierarchical structure of generative recommenders leads to more effective recommendations.
papers.scoring_note: 层级语义ID；五个公开数据集
papers.summary: 生成式推荐常默认 SID 的每个 token 各有独立含义。作者在 Amazon Beauty 上检查 RQ-VAE 的 ID：两件商品只有第一个 token 相同时，平均余弦相似度是 0.740；只有后三个 token 相同时仅 0.582，和随机抽两件差不多。==后面的 token 离开前缀就没有稳定含义==，SID 其实是树上的路径。AST 于是直接对商品 embedding 自顶向下聚类建树，每个节点按聚类质量决定分几叉。在五个 Amazon 数据集上，它比最强基线平均好 13.08%，各方法共用 embedding 和生成模型，差距只来自 ID 的构造。

papers.title: IntentLens: Grounding Underspecified Multimodal Queries for Recommendation via Tool-Augmented Reasoning
papers.authors: Xiao Chen, Dong Fang, Haitao Li, Qing Li
papers.abstract: As intelligent personal assistants are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios, recommendation paradigms are shifting from passive preference matching to inferring user intent from underspecified multimodal inputs. In practical interactions, users typically issue a reference image paired with a vague natural language query, keeping key visual attributes, personalized preferences, and item-side constraints implicit. Existing recommendation methods either leverage historical user interactions augmented with multimodal item features or assume fully articulated textual queries; both paradigms struggle to resolve underspecified multimodal queries for accurate item matching. To address this limitation, we propose IntentLens, a tool-augmented recommendation framework that grounds ambiguous multimodal queries into query-relevant evidence prior to user-item matching. IntentLens follows a ground-then-rank pipeline: a shared multimodal LLM leverages visual tools, user memory modules, and item attribute retrieval tools to (i) infer latent user intent from image-text inputs and (ii) augment each candidate item with fine-grained, query-conditioned evidence. Subsequently, a lightweight ranker scores candidates based on the grounded representations. To facilitate research in this novel setting, we construct two benchmarks with underspecified multimodal queries, namely \textsc{GoogleReview-MMTool} and \textsc{Yelp-MMTool}. Extensive experiments on these benchmarks demonstrate that IntentLens outperforms competitive MLLM and retrieval baselines, and exhibits strong generalization to unseen categories and datasets.
papers.scoring_note: 多模态意图理解；LLM辅助表征后判别式排序
papers.summary: 用户拿相机对着咖啡馆的一道菜问「类似这种感觉，但更实惠、适合在附近快速吃个午饭」。风格、预算都没说清，直接算 query 和候选的相似度很容易排错。IntentLens 在排序前加了一步：多模态大模型调用看图和查用户历史的工具，把模糊请求改写成清楚的文字 query。候选也补上评论、价格等信息，再由轻量双塔打分。在 Google 评论数据上，双塔和候选不动、只换 query，MRR 从 33.6% 升到 40.2%，标注好的标准 query 能到 44.4%。这些 query 是大模型合成的，一次请求要跑几秒。

papers.title: RoutingTrie: Metadata Routing for Constrained Generative Retrieval
papers.authors: Darshan Fofadiya, Yang Liu, Shuying Sun, Kyumin Park, Juhana Kangaspunta
papers.abstract: Advances in large language models and semantic IDs (SIDs) have brought generative retrieval (GR) into industrial applications. These systems must return items that satisfy request metadata constraints as well as relevance requirements. A catalog trie ensures SID validity, but filtering metadata only after generation wastes computation on rejected candidates and may leave too few eligible results. We propose RoutingTrie to incorporate metadata constraints before beam selection. RoutingTrie maintains one shared SID trie and builds a compact index for each metadata field using Dense Bitset or Sparse List. We derive a storage cost formula to guide the choice between these index representations for different field distributions. During decoding, field probes determine whether requested values occur below candidate edges and produce a combined mask that guides beam selection. Experiments on ShopTrie, our configurable synthetic benchmark, demonstrate compact storage and efficient CPU and GPU probing across diverse metadata distributions. In a production replay, RoutingTrie raises Hit@100 from 67.5\% to 96.1\%, a gain of 28.6 percentage points, with only 1.1 ms latency increase. We will release the ShopTrie generator, benchmark scripts, and RoutingTrie CPU and Triton GPU implementations to support reproducibility.
papers.scoring_note: 语义ID约束解码；合成基准，未视为生产实验
papers.summary: 生成式检索常要带条件，比如只要某家店的商品。常见做法是生成完再过滤，可 beam 早被别家店的候选占满，过滤后剩不下几个。RoutingTrie 把过滤提前到每一步 beam 选择之前：给 SID trie 的每条边记下它下面出现过哪些店铺、国家等取值，解码时先屏蔽到不了目标取值的分支。取值少的字段存位图，店铺 ID 这种取值极多的字段存排序列表。用生产系统回放历史购买记录，按店铺过滤时 Hit@100 从 67.5% 升到 96.1%，请求延迟只多 1.1 毫秒。==模型打分没变，涨幅来自 beam 不再被白占==。

papers.title: LEGIT: Live Eligibility Gating over Identifier Tries for Constrained Decoding of Heterogeneous Pages
papers.authors: Felix Fang, Zheng Liu, Robert Saliba
papers.abstract: A generative recommender names each candidate with a short token sequence, a Semantic ID, and recommends by generating those tokens. Some generative recommenders, including the Uber Eats search engine we are building, write a whole results page, stores with their menu items, in one decoding pass. Every Semantic ID on such a page must name a real store or item that is eligible for the search, such as a store that delivers to the user's location, and that is not already on the page. Each item must also belong to the store above it. A trie over the catalog keeps identifiers real, but eligibility and repetition change with every request and token, and the grammar-constrained decoder we tried could not enforce these changing rules exactly and quickly. We call this constraint LEGIT, for live eligibility gating over identifier tries. Numbering trie leaves depth first turns each rule into a range lookup over one store trie and one item trie, and every generated page passes an independent catalog check. On one NVIDIA B200 GPU with one or two requests per decode step, a direct implementation that walks the trie on the GPU makes each token about 5 times as slow as unconstrained decoding. Across 36 implementations, hardware counters and ablations are consistent with kernel launches and CPU-GPU waits as the source of this slowdown. Our fastest implementation walks the trie on the CPU while the GPU runs the model, needs no custom kernel, and cuts time per output token by 65.9 percent against the direct GPU implementation, to about 1.7 times the unconstrained cost. This implementation is also the fastest on a page layout that puts each item before its store.
papers.scoring_note: 整页生成约束；硬件消融，未声称生产A/B
papers.summary: Uber Eats 的生成式搜索要一次 decode 写完一整页店铺和菜品，每个 token 都得保证店铺真实、送得到、没重复，菜品也属于上面那家店。作者比了 36 种实现，最直接的 GPU 版每个 token 慢到无约束解码的约 5 倍，而 GPU 计算单元最多只有 5.42% 的时间在工作。硬件计数器和消融实验都指向 kernel 启动和 CPU 等 GPU 这两项开销。==约束的算术很轻，贵的是每组序列都要和 GPU 来回一趟==。把 trie 遍历放到 CPU、趁模型前向时跑完，成本降到约 1.7 倍，也不用写定制 kernel。

papers.title: SituRecBench: Evaluating Frontier Models as Situated Recommendation Assistants in 3D Environments
papers.authors: Jingtong Yang, Dongding Lin, Jian Wang, Wenjie Li
papers.abstract: Recommender systems are transitioning from static retrieval engines into interactive assistants grounded in physical environments. However, current studies largely neglect the combined complexities of spatial navigation, visual grounding, and multi-turn social interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce SituRecBench, an interactive benchmark for evaluating frontier vision-language models (VLMs) as situated recommendation assistants within high-fidelity 3D environments. We reformulate recommendation as a situated assistance process in which an assistant interacts with a user while sharing the user's egocentric view. Our benchmark simulates real-world shopping environments (e.g., supermarkets and home furnishings stores), requiring assistants to elicit preferences, ground recommendations in the environment, and guide the user to relevant locations through dialogue. The benchmark evaluates dialogue quality, recommendation utility, and navigation effectiveness through a unified interactive protocol. Extensive experiments reveal persistent challenges in spatial grounding and preference elicitation, highlighting limitations in their ability to integrate global contextual information with local observations. SituRecBench provides a rigorous foundation for advancing the development of situated assistants in the real world.
papers.scoring_note: 对话推荐基准；3D仿真，UGC适配成本较高
papers.summary: 把大模型放进 3D 超市和家具店当导购，共享用户的第一人称视角，一边问需求一边带路，最后看用户买不买。作者用模拟用户测了 7 个 VLM，最好的 Gemini 3.1 Pro 在超市成交率 80%，在家具店 66%，两个小模型只有三成左右。GPT-5.6 Sol 的指引最常被照做，成交却排在 Gemini 之后。在超市用 GPT-5.6 Sol 做消融时，去掉第一人称图像，成交率几乎不变；再去掉画面内容的文字标注，成交和对话评分才下降。==第一人称信息主要靠文字标注起作用==。

papers.title: Close and Sort: Exact Maximum-Likelihood Aggregation of Cyclic Rank-Two Preferences
papers.authors: Kehan Liu, Zhaoyun Chen, Xianquan Yan
papers.abstract: Pairwise probabilities arise in rank aggregation, recommendation, and human or LLM evaluation, yet converting them into a maximum-likelihood list is a weighted Kemeny problem and is NP-hard in general. Known exact algorithms for rank-two tournaments use only comparison signs and do not optimize this likelihood. We show that the weighted problem is exactly solvable when the skew-symmetric log-odds matrix $W_{ij}=\log(p_{ij}/p_{ji})$ has rank two, including when the induced preferences contain cycles. Writing $W_{ij}=\det(h_i,h_j)$ and adding the closing vector $h_0=-\sum_i h_i$ turns the objective into twice the signed area of a closed polygon. This geometry yields CloseSort, which polar-sorts the $n+1$ edge vectors, cuts after $h_0$, and returns a global maximum-likelihood order in $O(n\log n)$ time from the factors. The same geometry identifies the runner-up and gives a stability certificate beyond exact rank two. When the smallest determinant $\delta$ of two consecutive edges in the closed angular cycle is positive, it is exactly the best-to-runner-up log-likelihood gap. For $W=W_0+E$, the CloseSort order of $W_0$ has regret at most $\sum_{i<j}|E_{ij}|$ on $W$ and remains optimal whenever this sum is below $\delta$, a worst-case tight threshold. In 5,120 determinant-logit simulations, increasing the observations per pair from 4 to 64 raises the fraction on which rank-two projection outperforms the empirical plug-in optimum from 68.6% to 85.7%. On 3,600 Arena-Hard LLM-judge profiles drawn from 63 systems and ten judges, the leading rank-two component captures 89.2% of the log-odds energy. On profiles containing a directed majority triangle, CloseSort reduces normalized regret by 44% relative to Borda and improves the mean normalized objective over each of eight baselines. With factors supplied, it is 8,407 times faster than exact dynamic programming on 18-item rankings.
papers.scoring_note: 排序聚合可迁移；非生成式推荐
papers.summary: 把两两比较的胜率合成一张榜单，最大似然解是加权 Kemeny 问题，一般情况下 NP-hard，而大模型裁判的偏好还会成环。这篇论文证明，只要胜率的对数几率矩阵秩为二，带环也能精确求解。做法是给每个条目一个平面向量，再补一个让所有向量相加为零的闭合向量，榜单的似然就对应这些向量首尾相接围成的多边形面积。==按角度排序时面积最大，从闭合向量处切开就是最优榜单==。在大模型裁判数据上，秩二成分占 89.2% 的能量；有环的样本上，它和最优解的差距比 Borda 小 44%，无环样本上 Copeland 反而更好。
